# Vendored code

`+ptt/` holds ten files copied unmodified from
[fabric_anisotropy](https://github.com/hoffmaao/fabric_anisotropy) at commit
`9e10edc320bd4df1afebf3d2260065327b542116` (2026-09-23), so the tutorial runs on
a personal computer with nothing but MATLAB. They are the functions the lessons
read and compare against (`fabricGLS`, `traveltimeFabricML`, `fujitaModel`,
`ershadiFabric`, `quadpolFabricLS`) and everything those call.

Do not edit them here. To update, re-copy from a newer fabric_anisotropy commit
and change the hash above.
